svg.title: Visible AI Consumption Closing
svg.desc: A closing synthesis showing invisible AI usage on the left, a telemetry seam in the center, and visible AI consumption on the right.
svg.text: From invisible dependency to visible operating signal.

g.text: Scattered work creates hidden capacity risk.
Capacity was part of delivery, but no one could see it.
Instrumented work creates earlier, better decisions.
Leaders can see which work deserves protection, review,
rescoping, or more capacity before the threshold hits.

svg.text: From invisible dependency to visible operating signal.
